worldcombat.skill.suckerpunch.summary: Flash in and stab the instant the foe starts to move; if the foe is not readying an attack, the strike whiffs and its PP is still spent.
worldcombat.skill.suckerpunch.use.0: Punish a hand that is already raised
worldcombat.skill.suckerpunch.use.1: Get one hit in before the foe's heavy blow
worldcombat.skill.suckerpunch.use.2: Steady damage on an enemy that keeps closing in
worldcombat.skill.suckerpunch.descriptio: Flash in for a stab of about %1$s damage; the living body it strikes must have attacked within the last %2$s (a real melee/projectile hit or a scripted attack move), or the strike whiffs.
Blink distance %1$s blocks, %2$s blocks/tick, hit radius %3$s blocks; the target is shoved back %4$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.suckerpunch.read.on: Read on: the read window is +0.6 s and the stab +15%, but the wind-up is +2 ticks and cooldown +6 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.suckerpunch.read.off: Read off: an almost instant snatch, shorter cooldown, but only the attack right in front of you counts.
worldcombat.skill.suckerpunch.timing: Cast on an enemy within %1$s blocks; %2$s after starting it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s and goes on a %5$s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.suckerpunch.growth.0: At level %1$s the stab rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.suckerpunch.growth.1: At level %1$s the stab rises to %2$s and the blink reaches %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.suckerpunch.preference: On: read window +0.6 s and stab +15%, but wind-up +2 ticks and cooldown +6 ticks. Off: an almost instant snatch with a shorter cooldown, but only the attack right in front of you counts.
Only blink in when the foe is this close; this move's blink is short, so a larger value often still cannot reach.
worldcombat.skill.suckerpunch.descriptio: It blinks toward the aimed direction; the first body it strikes whiffs unless that body is inside its attack window, and terrain or an empty path whiffs the same way. The direction is free to gamble on, and a whiff still spends.
